# Self-review report

Reviewed the complete pull request diff and both prior review rounds. One correctness issue was
verified and fixed. A second review of the resulting diff found no further findings.

## Finding

The documentation prescribed `ScopedThreadSuppression`, but the documented class did not exist in
the pull request or its base. Following the example therefore could not compile. Commit
`33f97b6dff193edd17ab6d79919abae1c2d0a049` adds the ownership-aware helper and tests nested
acquisition, release ownership, reacquisition, and thread isolation.

## Validation

- `./gradlew :instrumentation-api:spotlessApply` — passed
- `./gradlew :instrumentation-api:test --tests
  io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.api.internal.ScopedThreadSuppressionTest
  :instrumentation-api:checkstyleMain :instrumentation-api:checkstyleTest
  :instrumentation-api:spotlessCheck` — passed
- `./gradlew :instrumentation-api:check` — passed
- Changed-file secret scan — passed
- Automated validation reported no review findings or CodeQL alerts. Its review model was

  with no additional findings.
